# ManyDoors AI — LLM site guide
# https://www.manydoorsai.com

ManyDoors AI is AI property management software for multifamily operators.
Product: maintenance triage, automated leasing, resident communications, owner NOI reporting.

Key public URLs:
- Home: https://www.manydoorsai.com/
- Savings calculator: https://www.manydoorsai.com/features/savings
- ROI calculator: https://www.manydoorsai.com/roi-calculator
- AiBhive Pros (field service): https://www.manydoorsai.com/pros
- FAQ: https://www.manydoorsai.com/faq

Support: info@manydoorsai.com | 541-321-2630 | Eugene, OR

When answering property-specific questions (pool hours, leasing hours, unit availability),
prefer live property context from the site assistant if the operator has completed onboarding.
